entries.text: The published corpus adds 58 replacement local bundles across ClickHouse Local, DataFusion, and SQLite generated with SQLGlot fork 30.24.0.17 (the two SQLite Read Primitives bundles and ten ClickHouse Local and DataFusion CoffeeShop, TPC-DI and ClickBench bundles with 30.25.0.2) and raw-text DuckDB source dialect translation, resolving superseded SQL translations from prior releases.
